content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the failure to propagate error codes from the function `__sso_led_dt_parse()` to its caller. This oversight meant that when an error occurred during the parsing of LED properties, the caller was not informed of the failure, leading to potential misbehavior or crashes in the driver. The patch corrects this by ensuring that error codes are returned appropriately, allowing the caller to handle errors as intended.
